## Summary

- Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run ci:local`
- [ ] If auth behavior changed, include relevant focused test commands/results.
- [ ] If docs/report scripts changed, confirm regenerated artifacts are included.
- [ ] `npm run docs:drift` passes with no generated-artifact changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran local CI-equivalent checks.
- [ ] I did not commit unrelated generated files by mistake.
- [ ] I updated docs where behavior or workflow changed.
